geographicProposal.groundContactBasis: Two inspected pictures confirm white portal towers, paired inclined hangers, continuous suspension cables and a thin deck. Standard viewer PMTiles named M48 bridge roads and tower-adjacent path offsets establish the main-span midpoint and east/southeast Aust-facing native+X. Mapped tower spacing986.5m matches the retained987.5m source within about1m. The named road includes a separate eastern approach, which remains outside this1637.5m suspension/anchorage asset. LocalY0 is deliberately accepted as an approximate global sea plane; no tidal or engineering datum certification. PMTiles water masks and raw terrain provide the surrounding review fixture; physical road endpoints remain approximate.

placementStatus: Approximate PMTiles crossing fit and global sea-plane visualization.
limitations: Pictures and standard viewer PMTiles determine approximate fit; the working sea plane is not a certified vertical/tidal datum.
Original detailed geometry is preserved and byte-reproduced; shared graphs supply reusable painted steel and concrete grain. Road material uses a dark aggregate approximation.

Skyline uses representative suspension/hanger ribbons; district reconstructs broader cables. Street/closeup reductions simplify rails, fittings and narrow markings; source retains all authored geometry.

Separate approach bridges are excluded. Connected road fitting is requested, but exact host endpoint joins and tides are not surveyed. Mapped-water preview is not bathymetry. Footprint replacement off; physical-device timings remain pending.
